verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Power-up + Reset (FFh) sequence — first Reset within 5 ms; subsequent Reset ≤ 500 µs; Synchronous Reset (FCh) ≤ 5 µs; Reset LUN (FAh) per device.
Discovery — Read ID (90h, 20h) → 'ONFI' signature; Read Parameter Page (ECh) → CRC + redundancy + revision-number bitmap.
Parameter Page CRC verification — polynomial 8005h, init 4F4Eh; iterate 3 redundant copies on mismatch.
Extended Parameter Page — signature 'EPPS' at bytes 2-5; section type 2 = Extended ECC Information; CRC at bytes 0-1.
Read Unique ID (EDh) — 16 × (UID + complement); validate XOR-equals-all-ones.
Read (00h/30h) — single-page read; tR; FAIL bit on EZ NAND; CSP threshold reporting.
Page Program (80h/10h) — single-page program; tPROG; FAIL bit reports outcome; tADL between addr and data.
Block Erase (60h/D0h) — block erase; tBERS; FAIL bit; refusal of factory-bad-block erase.
Multi-LUN parallelism — Read on LUN0 + Page Program on LUN1 in parallel; per-LUN R/B_n contribution via wired-OR; Read Status Enhanced per LUN.
Multi-plane Page Program (80h/11h .. 80h/10h) — concurrent plane program; per-plane FAIL via 78h.
Multi-plane Block Erase (60h/D1h .. 60h/D0h) — concurrent erase.
Multi-plane Read (00h/32h .. 00h/30h) — concurrent read.
Page Cache Program (80h/15h .. 80h/10h) — pipelined; FAILC reports prior-command result.
Read Cache Random / Sequential / End (00h/31h, 31h, 3Fh) — pipelined read.
Copyback Read + Program (00h/35h + 85h/10h) — on-die copy; Small Data Move modify-subset.
Change Read Column (05h/E0h) + tCCS — within-page reposition for read.
Change Read Column Enhanced (06h/E0h) — multi-LUN page-register access.
Change Write Column (85h) + tCCS — within-page reposition for write.

Set Features / Get Features round-trip — Timing Mode (01h), NV-DDR2/3 Configuration (02h), I/O Drive Strength (10h), External Vpp (39h), Volume Configuration (58h), DCC/training (08h-0Bh), EZ NAND control (80h-81h).
Data interface switch — Set Features (01h) SDR → NV-DDR → NV-DDR2 → NV-DDR3; verify data integrity in each mode.
ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) + Short (D9h) — output driver impedance; FAIL bit.
Implicit DCC Training (18h, NV-DDR3) — duty-cycle correction.
Read DQ Training (62h, NV-DDR3) — fixed pattern; host phase sweep.
Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern + 64h readback, NV-DDR3) — round-trip pattern match.
Write RX DQ Training (76h, NV-DDR3) — device-side RX training.
Volume Select (E1h) + Volume Appointment via Set Features (58h) — CE_n pin reduction enumeration.
ODT Configure (E2h) — matrix-termination Deselected/Selected/Sniff states.
Status invalidation — RDY=0 invalidates SR[5:0] except WP_n bit 7.
Composite Status (Table 102) — multi-plane bits OR into Read Status (70h) composite byte.
WP_n disables Program/Erase but not Read; WP_n stability rule during Program / Erase / Write Enable active.
tCCS / tADL / tWHR / tWB / tRR timing budgets — per timing-mode table (Section 4.17).
Reset combinations — FFh from various states (Idle / Reading / Programming / Erasing); FCh keeps interface; FAh per-LUN.
Read Status Enhanced restrictions — shall NOT be used during Target-level commands (Read Parameter Page, Read ID, ZQ Calibration, Volume Select).
Factory defect map — first byte of spare area of first/last page of bad block ≠ FFh; verify erase of marked block fails.
Independent Data Buses (Section 2.16) — DQ_0 + DQ_1 parallel operation per package.
Pin-sharing rules — WE_n/CLK shared pin across SDR/NV-DDR family transitions; RE_n/W/R_n/RE_t shared pin; verify clean transitions on data-interface switch.
fields.notes: ONFI 4.1 does not include a normative verification plan with assertions or specific testbench inputs. The above categories are derived from Sections 2 (Physical Interface), 3 (Memory Organization), 4 (Data Interface and Timing), 5 (Command Definition), 6 (Multi-plane Operations), 7 (Behavioural Flows), and Appendices. The four founding vendors (Intel, Micron, Phison, Western Digital, SK Hynix, Sony) maintain internal qualification suites which are not part of the public specification.
